record.notes: Channel Street (open space) -- the Design Controls' Section 3.7 open space between Blocks B and C, from 3rd Street to the Shared Public Way: a 50 ft plaza with a 12 ft pedestrian throughway, a tree grove and active edges along both blocks. Its own real Assessor lot, 8719C004 (1,110 m2, recorded 2020-06-12 with the Seawall Lot 337 subdivision), matching Figure 3.1.1's Channel Street rectangle. Recorded as 'planned' rather than 'complete': the 2019 Phase 1 submittal delivered an interim pedestrian plaza here ('two interim pedestrian plazas south of Parcels B and F', with Channel Street given an interim treatment), and the permanent open space design comes with Block C. Satellite imagery shows paving and planting on the lot today. Added 2026-09-17 (Mission Rock geometry brief).
